plan: - Electrical: Micro flight controller (MCU, IMU), micro brushless motors, ESCs, small LiPo battery, miniature radio receiver, FPV camera, tiny VTX, miniature microphone. - Mechanical: Ultra-light carbon fiber or plastic frame, micro propellers, motor mounts, vibration dampeners. - 3D-printed: Custom enclosure resembling a fly, battery holder, mounting points for electronics, camera mount, microphone housing. - Power management: Dedicated BEC for camera/VTX/mic to ensure stable voltage.

subSteps.title: 3D print all structural and mounting components
Clean and deburr all 3D printed parts
Test fit mounts and enclosures with their respective components and the drone frame
Solder motor wires to the flight controller
Solder radio receiver power and data wires to the flight controller (3.3V, GND, UART1 TX/RX)
Solder LiPo battery main power (XT30) to the step-down converter input
Solder step-down converter 5V output to camera module and microphone power inputs
Solder camera module data (UART2 TX/RX) to flight controller, and microphone audio out to camera module audio in
Solder LiPo battery main power (VBAT, GND) to flight controller power inputs
Perform continuity checks on all soldered connections, verify no shorts
Connect flight controller to computer and flash appropriate firmware
Configure flight controller UARTs for radio receiver and camera module
Calibrate ESCs and verify motor spin direction using flight controller software
Verify radio receiver communication with the flight controller and configure channels
Test camera module and microphone functionality, verify video and audio output
Configure failsafe settings on the flight controller
Mount flight controller, radio receiver, camera module, and microphone into their 3D printed mounts
Mount all motor mounts to the drone frame using M2 nylon screws and nuts
Secure flight controller, radio receiver, camera module, and microphone assemblies to the drone frame using M2 nylon screws and nuts
Mount motors into their respective motor mounts
Secure LiPo battery into its holder and mount the holder to the drone frame
Route all wires neatly, secure with miniature cable ties, and ensure strain relief
Attach the fly body enclosure to the drone frame using M2 nylon screws
Install propellers on the motors, ensuring correct orientation
